headlines.title: Study estimates 75% of NFL players who died over 15-year span had CTE
headlines.description: An estimated 75% of professional football players who died over a 15-year span had signs of chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE, a study published Wednesday found. It’s the highest estimation to date.

headlines.title: CDC’s deputy director to depart after four months in the role
headlines.description: Dr. Jennifer Shuford, the CDC’s deputy director, is leaving the agency after less than five months. It’s the latest example of the leadership turnover that has roiled the CDC.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: Mel Robbins on How to ‘Quiet the Noise’ That Can Overwhelm You
headlines.description: Through her bestselling book, “The Let Them Theory,” a global tour and her award-winning podcast, Mel Robbins has made it her mission to help people change their lives. She joins TODAY to share how you can quiet the noises that overwhelm you.

headlines.title: Dr. Jen Ashton Answers TODAY Viewers' Top Health Questions
headlines.description: Dr. Jen Ashton, board-certified in OBGYN and obesity medicine and host of the popular “Dear Dr. Jen” podcast, joins TODAY to share her professional opinions on top health questions from viewers.

headlines.title: New Report Finds Produce Imported Into US is ‘Rarely’ Inspected
headlines.description: A troubling new report finds much of the fresh produce imported into the United States is rarely inspected. A Washington Post investigation calls it a “major blind spot” when it comes to food safety in America. NBC’s Stephanie Gosk reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Inside Groundbreaking Guidelines for Heart Disease in Women
headlines.description: Four major health groups, including the American Heart Association, came together to create a whole new playbook for preventing and treating heart disease beginning very early in life. Dr. Jennifer Haythe, a cardiologist at New York Presbyterian Columbia University Medical Center, joins TODAY to detail the updated guidelines.

headlines.title: Jennifer Lawrence just launched a hair care line, and you can already save on the staples
headlines.description: Jennifer Lawrence launched Mes° hair care with three products: Multitask Repair Mask, Off-Duty Restyling Serum and Good Roots Volume Mist. If you buy the bundle, you get $10 off.

headlines.title: How to use every type of over-the-counter teeth whitening product (and which ones really work)
headlines.description: Experts share the best over-the-counter teeth whitening products of 2026 for a brighter smile, including Crest Whitestrips, Sensodyne and whitening pens.

headlines.title: 29 beauty Advent calendars so good you’ll open all the doors on the first day
headlines.description: Shop the best beauty Advent calendars across skin care, hair care, fragrances and more, from brands like E.l.f., Charlotte Tilbury, L’Occitane, and Jo Malone.

headlines.title: How to clean your vacuum and help it last for years, according to an expert
headlines.description: To learn how to clean a vacuum, I spoke to a home cleaning expert for their advice and recommendations. Here’s how to do it to make sure your appliance lasts.

headlines.title: Country Singer Jillian Cardarelli Reveals the 1 Uncommon Symptom She Noticed Before Her Breast Cancer Diagnosis
headlines.description: Country artist Jillian Cardarelli is making her Grand Ole Opry debut at Opry Goes Pink after battling and beating breast cancer at age 33 over the summer.
